create_tensor_quantized: create a 1D ggml tensor with quantized data type Q5_K and specified size
build_computation_graph: build a forward computation graph by expanding it with an add operation node
run_graph_compute: run ggml graph computation with a specified number of threads on a context
copy_numpy_to_tensor: copy a numpy array into a ggml tensor for computation
convert_tensor_to_numpy: convert a ggml tensor back to a numpy array with optional copy
